originalTitle: Australia v Bangladesh: first men’s Test, day one – live
summary: Over-by-over report : Australia begin a busy 12 months featuring at least 20 Tests with Bangladesh up first in Darwin. Join our writers for updates
content: Test cricket in Australia in August? Yes please. And so it begins. Over the next 12 months the Australian men’s Test team will play 20 Test matches (21 if they make the World Test Championship final) in a year that will likely define an era. Much has been made about the wizened age of the current Aussie outfit -with only Cameron Green under the age of 30 in the likely starting XI against Bangladesh in Darwin today. This is not a team that is preparing for the future, but it is one that could win a hell of a lot of Test cricket in the next 12 months and yah-boo to whatever follows. Pat Cummins intimated he is all about the here and now in his pre-match comments: We don’t look too far ahead. We as a group are quite good at just being quite present, not thinking too far ahead and moving on from one game to the next. For us at the moment, it’s all Bangladesh this series.” The ‘Fab Four’ are reunited too – the ever present and ever impressive (just ask England’s batting card…) Mitchell Starc is rejoined by Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood and Nathan Lyon, the first time the quartet will line up together in over a year. No questions about the golden quality of the bowling then but a few question marks over the Aussie batting order with plenty of scrutiny on the aforementioned Green and Jake Weatherald at the top of the order. Bangladesh haven’t been Down Under for a Test series since 2003 and Darwin hasn’t hosted a Test match since 2004. Play begins at 10am local time and 10:30am AEST, the teams and the toss are imminent. As ever, please do get in touch as we go along. Shall we?
chineseTitle: 澳大利亚对阵孟加拉国：第一次男子测试，第一天——现场直播
chineseSummary: 详细报告：澳大利亚开始了忙碌的 12 个月，其中至少有 20 项测试，孟加拉国首先在达尔文进行测试。加入我们的作家以获取更新
chineseContent: 八月在澳大利亚进行板球测试？是的，请。事情就这样开始了。在接下来的 12 个月里，澳大利亚男子测试队将在一年内进行 20 场测试赛（如果他们进入世界测试锦标赛决赛则将参加 21 场比赛），这可能会定义一个时代。对于目前澳大利亚队的衰老年龄，人们已经进行了很多讨论——今天在达尔文对阵孟加拉国的比赛中，可能首发的十一人中只有卡梅伦·格林还不到30岁。这不是一支为未来做准备的球队，但它是一支可以在未来 12 个月内赢得大量板球测试赛冠军的球队，并且对接下来的一切充满期待。帕特·康明斯在赛前评论中暗示，他只关心此时此地：我们不会看得太远。作为一个团队，我们非常擅长专注于当下，不考虑太远，从一场比赛继续进行下一场比赛。目前对我们来说，这个系列赛就是孟加拉国的比赛。” “披头士四人组”也重聚了——永远存在且令人印象深刻的人（只要问问英格兰队的击球卡就知道了……）米切尔·斯塔克与帕特·康明斯、乔什·黑兹尔伍德和内森·里昂重新联手，这是四人组一年多来首次齐聚。毫无疑问，保龄球的黄金品质，但对澳大利亚击球顺序有几个问号，对前面提到的位于顺序顶部的格林和杰克韦瑟拉德进行了大量审查。孟加拉国自 2003 年以来就没有参加过澳大利亚测试赛，达尔文自 2004 年以来也没有举办过测试赛。比赛于当地时间上午 10 点和澳大利亚东部标准时间上午 10:30 开始，球队和比赛即将开始。一如既往，请在我们进行过程中保持联系。我们可以吗？
